title: Bounded scalar curvature and smooth extension of four-dimensional Ricci flow
summary: We prove that a smooth Ricci flow on a closed real four-manifold extends on the same manifold through every finite time at which its scalar curvature remains uniformly bounded. This resolves the scalar-curvature extension problem in dimension four.
family_title: Scalar curvature and finite-time Ricci-flow singularities

review.reason: Shows four-dimensional Ricci flows extend smoothly through times of bounded scalar curvature.
